name: Honda CRF250L
intro: Honda's small dual-sport. 2014-2015 bikes have a starter relay recall, and some 2020 bikes have a reflector recall.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. 2014-2015 bikes are in recall 15V439 (starter relay). Some 2020 bikes are in recall 21V382 (rear reflector).

recalls.fix: Dealer replaces the starter relay free.

recalls.what: Rear reflector lens may be too dim to meet the lighting standard.
recalls.fix: Dealer replaces the rear reflector free.
